pourready.title: PourReady // 01
pourready.desc: Field-tested concrete volume and structural geometry estimator used daily on active jobsites. Fast calculations for slabs, footings, walls, and columns with custom waste margins.

shotstack.title: ShotStack Studio // 02
shotstack.desc: Visual storyboard compiler allowing video editors, film directors, and design teams to compile images, screenshots, and annotation notes into an exportable PDF layout.

tap.title: TAP: Time & Place // 03
tap.desc: Authenticated field tracking protocol providing cryptographic proofs of location, activity, and duration directly from active project sites.

ampliloop.title: AmpliLoop Studio // 04
ampliloop.desc: Experimental Blazor WebAssembly audio DSP testbench. Explores algorithmic rap beat generation, high-precision metronome timing, and client-side software instrument tuning.

aac.title: Anytime Animal Control // 05
aac.desc: Live wildlife removal and control service website. Provides field diagnostics, coverage maps, dispatch contacts, and pest management information.

intake.title: Dondlinger Voice Intake // 06
intake.desc: Frictionless voice-first client onboarding. Tap to record your project vision securely via microphone, transmitting directly to the local inbox.

omw.title: On My Way (OMW) // 07
omw.desc: Live GPS and ETA broadcasting tool for field technicians. (Currently offline undergoing maintenance and protocol refactoring).

zla.title: Zero Liability Architecture // 08
zla.desc: Client-side computing architecture specification for running business utilities entirely in-browser without central servers, accounts, or data storage liability.

heckler.title: Heckler Audio Synth // 09
heckler.desc: Experimental Blazor WASM audio synthesis sandbox for soundboard triggers, tone synthesis algorithms, and low-latency audio event testing.

timeline.title: TimelineZLA Sync // 10
timeline.desc: Secure, local-first daily log and project timeline builder. Enables teams to construct site timelines and peer-to-peer sync via 6-digit codes with instant PDF export.

skydrop.title: SkyDrop Peer Transfer // 11
skydrop.desc: Instantaneous direct WebRTC peer-to-peer file sharing utility between devices. Operates with zero cloud intermediate storage and zero logins.

touchscreen.title: Touchscreen Diagnostic // 12
touchscreen.desc: Interactive client-side hardware diagnostic PWA. Verify touchscreen hardware responsiveness, paint touch grids to identify dead zones, and monitor ghost touches in real-time.

wazweather.title: WaZ Weather Dashboard // 13
wazweather.desc: Blazor WASM atmospheric telemetry, live radar mapping, USGS river hydrology flow rates, and rain outlook dispatch for Wisconsin Rapids and Central Wisconsin.

personalization.title: Personalization Engine // 14
personalization.desc: Metropolis desktop customizer, dynamic glassmorphism theme generator, and Metropolis taskbar state manager.

theater.title: Neural Cinema & Theater // 15
theater.desc: Streaming neural radio theater, multi-speaker audio dramas, 9:16 vertical cinema, and typeset screenplays engineered by John Dondlinger.

architecture.title: Metropolis Architecture Spec // 16
architecture.desc: Technical systems engineering whitepaper (METRO-SPEC-2026.08-REV1) running on interactive MudBlazor WebAssembly. Details Win32 CreateProcessW array dispatching, zero-copy DXGI to CUDA SM_89 VRAM delta pipeline (1,470 FPS), and DuckDB OLAP telemetry.
